CONFIG_UML_NET: requested; symbol DOES NOT EXIST in Linux 6.19.14 ARCH=um Kconfig (only CONFIG_UML_NET_VECTOR exists) -> olddefconfig dropped the unknown symbol; no CONFIG_UML_NET line in final .config
CONFIG_UML_NET_VECTOR: not set -> y (survived olddefconfig; the sole UML net Kconfig family in 6.19.14)
CONFIG_UML_NET_SLIRP: requested; symbol DOES NOT EXIST in 6.19.14 (no 'slirp' string anywhere in arch/um/) -> dropped as unknown by olddefconfig; .config NOT hand-edited per directive
CONFIG_MODULES: y -> not set (survived; all module infra symbols removed, all 11 former =m promoted to =y except CONFIG_SLIP and CONFIG_SLIP fragment lines)
CONFIG_SLIP: m -> not set (survived; dead-module trap eliminated)
eds_olddefconfig_deltas: CONFIG_STATIC_LINK=y DROPPED (unrequested): CONFIG_UML_NET_VECTOR 'select MAY_HAVE_RUNTIME_DEPS' conflicts with STATIC_LINK 'depends on !MAY_HAVE_RUNTIME_DEPS'. Final .config: CONFIG_MAY_HAVE_RUNTIME_DEPS=y, CONFIG_LD_SCRIPT_DYN=y, CONFIG_LD_SCRIPT_DYN_RPATH=y. CONSEQUENCE: candidate-2 `linux` is DYNAMICALLY linked (interpreter /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2) whereas candidate-1 was statically linked. Enabling the UML vector net family and STATIC_LINK are mutually exclusive in 6.19.14 Kconfig; the net flip was given priority per directive.
11 former =m symbols promoted to =y by MODULES=n: IOSCHED_BFQ, BINFMT_MISC, BLK_DEV_LOOP, BLK_DEV_NBD, DUMMY, TUN, PPP, AUTOFS_FS, ISO9660_FS, SLHC, (SLIP -> not set instead)
